Thanks for the walkthrough on Friday. We attached the vendor onboarding packet and the W-9. Please let us know when the PO number will be issued so we can schedule our go-live with engineering.

From: monica_patel@redwood.com

Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding: paperwork attached

Thanks Elena — received and reviewing. Quick heads-up: our PO issuance workflow requires a legal entity Tax ID in the onboarding form and the W-9 tax id must match the submitted company name. The PDF you uploaded looks like a generic template and the onboarding JSON field "tax_id" is empty. This blocks procurement from creating a single consolidated PO in our system.

Can you confirm the company legal name exactly as filed and provide the Tax ID? If there are constraints on sharing the full Tax ID we can accept a redacted version for the portal and then have procurement confirm in the final step.

Next steps from Redwood side: Ben (ops) and Karthik (procurement) — when we have the Tax ID we can either:
- Issue one PO for the full 60k (preferred) or
- Split into two provisional POs to respect your internal spend caps (example: 40k / 20k) while we complete verification.

Monica
Monica Patel
Vendor Onboarding | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com
(415) 555-0182
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@acmeops.com>
To: monica_patel@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@acmeops.com
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding: paperwork attached

Monica — apologies, our internal intake accidentally omitted the EIN. Attached is an updated W-9 (AcmeOps_W9_2026.pdf, v2) with EIN: 12-3456789 and the onboarding JSON now includes "tax_id":"12-3456789".

We do have a corporate spend policy that caps single-PO commitments at 50k without additional approvals. For timing, we need at least the integration line certified this month, so if you can issue a partial PO for integration (up to 25k) while the rest awaits approvals, that would work.

Thanks,
Elena

Attachments: AcmeOps_W9_2026.pdf (application/pdf)
From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: monica_patel@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: AcmeOps PO strategy + line-item split recommendation

Monica / Karthik — per AcmeOps' note on the 50k single-PO cap, recommend we do the following to minimize manual churn and avoid multiple redlines in billing:

1) Issue PO-79432 (partial) for Integration Services (line 1) = $25,000 — immediate.
2) Issue PO-79433 (standby) for Training + Compute (lines 2-3) = $35,000 — set expiry 90 days and mark as conditional pending AcmeOps internal approval.
3) Tag both POs with vendor_account_code: ACME-2026 and include onboarding docs link.

Operational notes: our system supports provisional status, which prevents accounting from booking until tax verification is complete — but Elena already provided EIN and W-9 v2 which should let procurement lift provisional once their approval comes back.

Laura — can you create the two POs and push them for signature today? I can follow up with an on-record note for finance so the partial PO doesn't break forecasting.

-Ben
From: monica_patel@redwood.com
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@acmeops.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 18 Oct 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: PO numbers issued: PO-79432 (integration) + PO-79433 (pending approval)

Elena — thanks for the quick turnaround and for providing the EIN. We created two POs to match your spend governance:

- PO-79432 — Integration Services — $25,000 — Issued, valid immediately.
- PO-79433 — Training + Initial Compute — $35,000 — Created as conditional; will activate after AcmeOps internal approval (expiry: 2027-01-16).

Attachments: PO-79432.pdf (purchase-order/pdf), PO-79433-draft.pdf (purchase-order/pdf)

Action items for AcmeOps: please confirm that PO-79433 is approved by your finance approver and send a quick approval note (procurement@acmeops.com). Once we receive confirmation we'll flip PO-79433 from conditional to active and lift the provisional flag in our accounting system.

Notes / audit trace: onboarding packet and W-9 v2 are linked here: https://drive.redwood.com/s/AcmeOps/onboarding-packet — Jira PROC-1294 updated with PO numbers.

If you'd like a single consolidated PO after your approvals are in place we can retroactively consolidate and issue a combined PO number, but that will require re-authorization in our finance ledger.

Monica
